subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Dumpster Diving for Data
description: A fast breakdown of Dumpster Diving for Data for builders.

hook.text: Your trash tells your whole story. Bank statements, medical bills, pre-approved credit offers.

buildup.text: Dumpster divers sort through garbage looking for documents with personal information.

discovery.text: A single bank statement can provide your account number, address, and spending patterns.

twist.text: In most places, trash on the curb is legally public property. Taking it isn't even illegal.

climax.text: A $30 shredder can prevent a crime that costs victims an average of $1,100 to resolve.

punchline.text: Your most sensitive documents belong in a shredder, not a bin.

quiz.question: Why is dumpster diving effective for identity thieves?
options: People throw away documents with personal information
It's done at night when no one watches
